summary: Share Ollama model catalog reads through canonical Procache

delivery.outcome: Repeated Ollama catalog reads reuse canonical metadata cache while health stays live and failure never duplicates transport
nonGoals: Caching mutations, streaming or authorization decisions
Dependency version changes or publication of pre-existing unrelated commits

architecture.decision: Optional canonical CachedHTTPReads adapter wraps only successful validated model catalogs; retain live health, explicit freshness and one-call fallback on storage failure
interfaceChanges: Optional fresh keyword on model catalog read
architecture.rollback: Revert the exact implementation through protected delivery

validation.evidence: Actual canonical cache: repeated read, concurrency, host separation, expiry, live health/freshness, malformed payload and storage-failure transport count
